_comment: Copilot CLI 1.0.88's model ids (`copilot help config`) and efforts (`copilot --help`), shown until the installed CLI has been asked (#360). The only place model ids are hardcoded.

config.about: log level for CLI; defaults to "default". Set to "all" for debug logging.
AI model to use for Copilot CLI; can be changed with /model command or --model flag option.

context window tier for tiered-pricing models (e.g., "default" or "long_context"). Can also be set with --context flag (overrides persisted setting) Can be changed with /model command (context tier picker appears for eligible models)
